task:
Create an Ingress resource with path-based routing:

  1. Create Deployment 'api-backend' (image: nginx:1.21, 1 replica) in namespace 'default'
     Expose as ClusterIP Service 'api-svc' on port 8080 (targetPort 80)

  2. Create Deployment 'web-frontend' (image: nginx:1.21, 1 replica) in namespace 'default'
     Expose as ClusterIP Service 'web-svc' on port 80

  3. Create an Ingress named 'app-ingress' with:
     - ingressClassName: nginx
     - Host: example.com
     - Path /api  → api-svc:8080  (pathType: Prefix)
     - Path /     → web-svc:80   (pathType: Prefix)

Note: An Ingress controller must be installed for traffic to actually flow,
but the Ingress object itself can be created and validated without one.
hints: kubectl create ingress has imperative support: kubectl create ingress --help
Paths use pathType: Prefix or Exact
ingressClassName references which Ingress controller to use (nginx, traefik, etc.)
detailed_hints: kubectl create deploy api-backend --image=nginx:1.21 && kubectl expose deploy api-backend --name=api-svc --port=8080 --target-port=80
kubectl create deploy web-frontend --image=nginx:1.21 && kubectl expose deploy web-frontend --name=web-svc --port=80
